request: What is this t-shirt made of?

key_points: Request for an exception: escalate

key_points: Very angry customer + threat of public review: escalate

request: Where can I track my parcel?

request: Does this tent sleep 3 adults?

request: I'm disappointed with the service, my order arrived late.
key_points: Acknowledge receipt, apologise, empathetic tone

request: Can you resend my invoice?
key_points: Invoice resent on request, no condition

request: What is the deadline to return an item?
key_points: 30 days after receipt

request: A button on my puffer jacket fell off on the first day.

request: Hello, has my order left yet? I haven't received an email.
key_points: Shipping within 48 working hours; tracking email sent at shipping; tracking in My account

request: My promo code doesn't work.
key_points: Check validity date and minimum purchase

request: Can I change the size of my order that is being prepared?
key_points: Change possible if stock available, before shipping

request: I didn't receive the shipping confirmation email.
key_points: Email with tracking number sent at shipping; tracking in My account

request: I no longer have the original packaging, is that a problem for a return?
key_points: Labels and original packaging required

request: You refuse my late return, I think that's unfair.

request: What is the difference between size S and M for this t-shirt?

request: Where is my order? It's been 2 days since I placed it.
key_points: Shipping within 48 working hours; tracking in My account > My orders

request: I changed my mind, can I send back my bag received 3 days ago, never used?

request: I think my account has been hacked, there are orders I didn't place.
key_points: Suspected account hacking: escalate

request: How long to be refunded after my return?
key_points: 7 working days after receipt and inspection

request: How do I return an item?
key_points: Within 30 days, unworn product; return label and steps

request: I want to return a swimsuit that I tried on and whose packaging I opened.
key_points: Hygiene exclusion: polite refusal

request: Is this backpack compatible with a hydration bladder from another brand?
key_points: Information absent from the product sheet: escalate

request: I have a defect on a sweater received 20 days ago, how do I send it back?
key_points: Within 30 days: treat as a defect; free label

request: My parcel is announced for tomorrow, how can I track it precisely?
key_points: Tracking number by email; My account > My orders

request: My backpack has a manufacturing defect, what should I send you?
key_points: Description of the defect, photos, order no.

request: The carrier confirms my parcel is lost. Refund me today or I'll contact the consumer-protection authority.
key_points: Confirmed lost parcel + threat of report: escalate

request: Actually my parcel was at my neighbour's, all good, thanks!
key_points: Thank and close; no action or escalation

request: What is the delivery time for express?
key_points: Express: 24 to 48 h

request: Is the return free?
key_points: Free at a pickup point above €50; otherwise €4.90

request: I was charged twice for the same order.
key_points: One of the two is a temporary authorisation released within 5 working days

request: You received my return 9 working days ago and I don't have my refund.
key_points: 7-working-day deadline exceeded: check receipt date; not yet 14 days

request: I want to cancel my order placed an hour ago.
key_points: Cancellation possible before shipping; refund within 7 working days

request: Can I exchange my size 42 for a 43?
key_points: Exchange possible depending on stock

request: Tracking says delivered but I haven't received anything since yesterday.
key_points: Check neighbours and pickup point; escalate if not found after 48 h

request: My parcel has been marked delivered for 5 days, I asked the neighbours and the pickup point, nothing. I want a resend or a refund.
key_points: Not found after 48 h: escalate (resend or refund outside the assistant's scope)

request: I'd like to know the status of my order no. 48213.
key_points: Tracking in My account > My orders

request: My trainers are coming unstuck after 3 months, is that normal?
key_points: 2-year warranty; ask for photos and order no.; probable defect

request: My order has been in preparation for 4 working days, nothing is moving.
key_points: More than 48 working hours: apology, remaining time, tracking within 24 h

request: I'm not receiving the password reset email.
key_points: Check the junk mail folder, then the account address

request: It's been 16 days since I sent my parcel back and I still haven't been refunded.
key_points: Refund not received beyond 14 days: escalate

request: My parcel left 3 days ago and I've received nothing, should I worry?
key_points: Standard time 3 to 5 working days: not yet late

request: I bought this bag in store, can I return it to you online?
key_points: In-store purchases absent from the procedures: escalate

request: I ordered on Monday, it's Thursday and I have no tracking number.
key_points: More than 48 working hours: apology, check, tracking within 24 h

request: Will this item be back in stock?
key_points: Refer to the product sheet; no restocking promise

request: Hello, I haven't received an email with my tracking number, I ordered yesterday. Can you help me?
key_points: Shipping within 48 working hours; tracking email sent at shipping; tracking in My account

request: I forgot my password.
key_points: Reset link by email, valid 24 h

request: Can I pay in three instalments?
key_points: Payment in 3 instalments at no cost from €100

request: I've been charged twice for 8 working days, both amounts are still there.
key_points: Double charge confirmed after 5 working days: escalate

request: I'd like to change the colour of the item in my order that is being prepared.
key_points: Change possible before shipping, depending on stock

request: How do I change the email address of my account?
key_points: My account: change of contact details

request: I want to return a jersey personalised with my name.
key_points: Personalised products excluded from return

request: My water bottle has leaked since the first use 3 weeks ago, photos attached.
key_points: Confirmed defect: replacement or refund; free label

request: Is this jacket waterproof?
key_points: Answer with the characteristic from the product sheet

request: I want to cancel my order, it left yesterday.
key_points: No longer cancellable once shipped: return procedure

request: I wear a 42 shoe, which size of shorts should I take?
key_points: Refer to the size guide; do not guess

request: How long does it take to receive my order with standard delivery?
key_points: Standard: 3 to 5 working days after shipping

request: Is this bag machine-washable?
key_points: Answer only if care instructions appear on the product sheet

request: Will I be refunded on my card or with a credit note?
key_points: Refund by the same payment method as the order

request: What are the standard and express delivery times?
key_points: Standard 3 to 5 working days; express 24 to 48 h

request: How long is the warranty?
key_points: Legal conformity warranty: 2 years from delivery

request: The seam of my bag came apart after 2 weeks.
key_points: Defect: ask for description, photos, order no.; replacement or refund; free label

request: My order is €45, who pays the return costs?
key_points: Under €50: €4.90 paid by the customer

request: Do these shoes run small?
key_points: Size guide; compare with a well-fitting pair

request: I put the wrong address this morning, the order hasn't left yet. Can I correct it?
key_points: Address editable before shipping only

request: I've been waiting 4 days for an answer to my email, that's long.
key_points: Apology, acknowledgement of receipt, precise reply date (5 working days)

request: My parcel is 6 working days late, I just want a precise delivery date.
key_points: Carrier investigation; reply within 3 working days; do not promise a date

request: Is the return free for an €80 order?
key_points: Above €50: free at a pickup point

request: I want to change the delivery address but my order has already shipped.
key_points: Address editable only before shipping

request: I received my parcel 35 days ago, can I still return it?
key_points: Beyond the 30-day deadline: polite refusal, no exception

request: The zip of my jacket is broken, I received it 5 days ago.
key_points: Defect: photos and order no.; replacement or refund; free label

request: The strap of my climbing helmet gave way mid-route, I got a big fright.
key_points: Product with a safety risk: escalate

request: My payment was declined, what should I do?
key_points: Check the card details; offer another payment method

request: My parcel shipped 8 working days ago and still isn't here. Is that normal?
key_points: Delay beyond 5 working days: carrier investigation; reply within 3 working days

request: I'd like to send back my shoes received 10 days ago, never worn.
key_points: Within 30 days, unworn product: send return label and steps
